itens.titulo: Palantir Did Not Win the FAA Contract for SMART. Time to Buy the Stock Anyway?
itens.descricao: Palantir Did Not Win the FAA Contract for SMART. Time to Buy the Stock Anyway? Yahoo Finance
trechos: Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005.
But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase.
Nonetheless, despite those attributes, the 12-year, $875 million deal went to a company called Air Space Intelligence.
The company's stock trades at a P/E ratio of 164, and even its forward P/E reduces the earnings multiple to just 119.
When also factoring in a sales multiple of 80 and a price-to-book value ratio of 47, the stock appears priced to perfection by just about every measure.
In the first half of 2026, its nearly $3.6 billion in revenue increased by 89% compared with the same period in 2025.
Also, it earned $1.9 billion during the same period compared with $541 million in the same year-ago time frame.
